title: partner-cloud-marketplace-sync-prep-jamie-2026-03-30
content:
Goal: prep for 1:1 + weekly sync with cloud marketplace partners (AWS, GCP, Azure) and top channel partners. Focus: unblock listings, co-sell enablement, telemetry gaps, and upcoming promo windows.

Meeting details:
- When: 2026-03-31 10:00am PT (30m)
- Attendees: Jamie P (me), Alex K (partnerships), Priya R (GTM ops), AWS partner lead (TBD), GCP marketplace PM (TBD), Azure marketplace rep (TBD)
- Meeting type: weekly sync + quick 1:1 follow-ups where needed

Objectives (top 3):
1) Get concrete status and next steps for AWS listing (license, billing integration, co-sell readiness).
2) Surface GCP approval blockers and agree on owner/due dates.
3) Confirm Azure offer ingestion timeline + telemetry (billing IDs + metrics).

Agenda (30m):
- 0-5m: quick round robin updates (each partner 1-2 bullets)
- 5-12m: AWS updates & asks (billing integration, marketplace SKUs, co-sell enablement)
    - Ask: confirm whether AWS needs updated terms by 4/7
    - Ask: confirm technical contact for billing integration (expecting SRE or infra eng)
- 12-18m: GCP status (approval, testing, listing metadata)
    - Blocker: security review pending - need PRD link + contact
    - Quick ask: can GCP expedite admin review if we provide SOC2 attestation doc?
- 18-24m: Azure updates (offer onboarding, ingestion cadence, lead gen links)
    - Confirm if offer manifest requires changes for our dedicated/private SKUs
- 24-27m: Channel partner highlights (resellers + ISV co-sell ops)
- 27-30m: Action items recap + owners

Notes / talking points (shorthand):
- AWS
  - Billing: current blocker is mapping our internal SKU to AWS marketplace SKU. Ask Alex to follow up with AWS billing contact (Samir to intro).
  - Co-sell: need to confirm co-sell eligibility checklist. If we hit it, ask for joint GTM funds timeline.
  - Promotion windows: Q2 marketplace campaigns - deadline to opt-in 4/10. Decide by next week.

- GCP
  - Approval pipeline: security review stuck with GCP admin (ticket PRJ-9876). Priya to escalate via partner success rep.
  - Testing: the listing passes basic smoke tests but fails metadata mapping for private deployment features. Need schema examples from GCP.

- Azure
  - Offer ingestion: docs show 2-3 day ingestion once manifest submitted, but telemetry linkage often delayed 2 weeks. Request Azure to expedite for pilot customers.
  - Dedicated SKUs: check if Azure allows multiple SKU mapping for same offer (we think yes, but confirm).

Channel partners / resellers
- Update on reseller enablement doc (WIP): add section on pricing guidance for dedicated vs hosted. Link to draft: (confluence link in artifacts).
- Ask: get 2-3 partner references for case studies - target list: Stateful Labs, BrightWork, Lumenix (Jamie to reach out).

Metrics / telemetry to request from partners this week:
- Marketplace installs by customer size (SMB / mid / enterprise)
- Avg time-to-first-purchase after listing (days)
- Billing reconciliation delta (expected vs reported)

Prep TODOs (my list before meeting)
- [ ] Pull latest marketplace listing PDFs and diff vs current (Jamie) - due 2026-03-30 EOD
- [ ] Share SOC2 attestation + compliance one-pager with GCP contact (Priya) - due 2026-03-30
- [ ] Ask Samir to intro AWS billing contact (Alex) - ASAP
- [ ] Draft promotion opt-in decision note for exec review (Jamie/Alex) - due 2026-04-02

Follow-up action items (capture during meeting) - draft commitments to propose:
- AWS: Alex to get billing contact intro (Samir) - owner: Alex Kim - due 2026-04-02
- AWS: Legal to review updated marketplace T&Cs for dedicated SKUs - owner: Legal (cc Jamie) - due 2026-04-09
- GCP: Priya to escalate PRJ-9876 to partner success and request expedited security review - owner: Priya Reddy - due 2026-03-31
- Azure: Product to provide manifest clarifications re: dedicated/private mapping - owner: Product PM (TBD) - due 2026-04-06
- Channel: Jamie to collect 3 partner reference intros and brief one-pager - owner: Jamie Patel - due 2026-04-07

Notes to self:
- Keep asks specific and timeboxed. Partners respond better to short, clear asks with direct owner/due date.
- If they ask for telemetry samples, have anonymized CSV ready (pull from analytics, filter PII).
- Prep quick 1-slide summary for execs on Q2 marketplace ops (metrics + asks) - use this for promote decision.

Potential risks / escalation paths:
- If GCP security review not cleared by 4/7, escalate to partner lead + sales lead to request manual review window.
- If AWS requires legal sign-off on new billing terms that delays listing >2 weeks, ask for temporary promo listing (no billing integration) until full integration done.

References / links: 
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PCP-1234 (marketplace program doc)
- Jira: PRJ-9876 (GCP security review)
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01ABCDEF/p1710000000000

Draft email to send after sync (short):
Subject: Follow-up & action items from marketplace sync (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Hi all - thanks for the sync. Capturing the key actions below. Please reply with owner confirmations or if any timelines are unrealistic. Will follow up with ticket links + docs by EOD tomorrow.

(Action items list)

--Jamie

Misc scratch (notes-to-self):
- Could we run a small pilot co-sell campaign with AWS for 2 enterprise customers (target: reduce sales cycle by 20%)? Need to model expected uplift and attribution.
- Check whether we can surface private deployment examples in marketplace listing without violating marketplace policy (ask legal).
